meta.title: DardaChat
meta.description: DardaChat: boxed conversation games that gather people around questions that open hearts.

devUi.title: DardaChat components
devUi.intro: Developer-only page: every token and component in one place, in Arabic and English.

type.heading: Typefaces
type.bodyLabel: Text: IBM Plex Sans Arabic + IBM Plex Sans

colour.heading: Colours
colour.note: Every semantic colour is paired with an icon and text; colour is never the only signal.

specimen.h2: A conversation game in a box
specimen.body: DardaChat is a card game that gathers family and friends around simple questions that open long conversations. Every card is an invitation to hear a story not yet told.

icons.heading: Icons
icons.note: Inline SVG in the text colour, hidden from screen readers. Icons marked as directional mirror on Arabic pages.

buttons.heading: Buttons
buttons.note: Medium and large buttons meet the 44px touch target. Loading keeps the label and announces busy.

fields.heading: Form fields
fields.note: Every control has a visible label. Hints and errors are linked to the control; errors pair an icon with text.
fields.nameHint: As it should appear on the delivery label.
fields.emailError: This email is missing an @. Check it and try again.
fields.phoneHint: We send delivery updates to this number.
fields.messagePlaceholder: Write a few words to go with the box
fields.termsLabel: I agree to the terms of sale
fields.termsHint: Read the returns policy before ordering.
fields.newsLabel: Tell me about new question decks
fields.newsError: Choose whether you want news before continuing.

cards.heading: Cards
cards.note: Cards rest on the table: raised, sunken, outlined or brand-tinted.
cards.raisedBody: 120 question cards for evenings with parents, grandparents and cousins.
cards.outlineBody: Outlined cards sit quietly inside forms.
cards.brandBody: Questions for long evenings after iftar.

badges.heading: Badges
badges.note: Status is always text plus an icon, never colour alone.

dialog.heading: Dialog
dialog.note: Native modal: Esc or the close button closes it and focus returns to the button that opened it.
dialog.title: Remove this game from your cart?
dialog.description: You can add it again at any time.
dialog.body: The Family edition will leave your cart. Your other items stay as they are.

toast.heading: Notifications
toast.note: Short messages at the end of the screen. They pause while hovered or focused; errors are announced immediately.
toast.errorBody: Check the card details or choose cash on delivery.

tabs.heading: Tabs
tabs.note: Arrow keys follow the reading direction: on Arabic pages the left arrow moves to the next tab.
tabs.label: Game details
tabs.storyBody: Born around a family table: questions that turn a quiet evening into stories nobody had told before.
tabs.contentsBody: 120 question cards, 10 blank cards to write your own, and a cloth pouch.
tabs.deliveryBody: Delivered across the West Bank within 2 to 4 working days.

table.heading: Tables
table.note: A wide table scrolls sideways inside its own frame only; numeric columns align to the end of the line.
table.caption: Latest orders

pagination.heading: Pagination
pagination.note: Chevrons mirror in Arabic; links keep the filters in the URL.

empty.heading: Empty state
empty.note: Says what is missing and suggests the next step.
empty.title: Your cart is empty
empty.description: Pick a game that brings your people around the table, and we will bring it to your door.

skeleton.heading: Loading skeletons
skeleton.note: Announce loading once; the pulse stops when reduced motion is preferred.

price.heading: Prices
price.note: The old price is struck through, with hidden now/was words for screen readers.

locale.heading: Language switcher
locale.note: Takes you to the same page in the other language, keeps the query, and remembers your choice.

footer.tagline: Conversation games in a box, gathering loved ones around questions that open hearts.
footer.contactSoon: Contact channels and social accounts are coming soon.
